To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of a composite Web process depends on the performance of the individual services involved in it and that a Web service can be characterized as a composite of its individual components.
we have implemented a composite Web services tool, SCET.
(i) the execution of Web services is affected by the number of Web services in a process; and (ii) the execution of a Web service is affected by its number of inputs and outputs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance analysis and simulation of composite Web services.
the following aspects of performance analysis: (i) performance of individual Web service (ii) performance of a composed process (iii) execution monitoring of a composed process.
developing techniques for analysing the performance of Web processes, which can be used by Web process designers to evaluate the performance characteristics of a process before it is executed.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the paper presents a novel and comprehensive approach to performance analysis of Web services.
the proposed methodology and the tools developed in the course of this work have provided a framework to evaluate and analyse the performance of Web services and Web processes.

the performance of a composite Web service can be analysed by the following techniques: (1) Static analysis of the process specification (2) Dynamic analysis during the execution of a process (3) Static analysis of a process specification and dynamic analysis during the execution.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the paper discusses the need for a tool to compose services and evaluate their performance.
SCET is a tool for creating, executing and monitoring composite Web services.
SCET provides an environment for composing and executing Web processes, and it also provides the tools for analysing their performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of individual services can be analysed by executing the composed process.
SCET can be used as a tool for performance evaluation of a Web process by providing a mechanism for execution time analysis and performance monitoring.
SCET is a powerful tool for analysing the performance of composite Web processes.
